question: Omset per bulan tahun 2025 beserta selisihnya dengan bulan sebelumnya (bulan pertama jangan ditampilkan).
sql: SELECT x.bulan, x.total_omset, x.total_omset - x.omset_sebelumnya AS selisih FROM (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date)) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.bulan

question: Ranking bulan berdasarkan omset di tahun 2025 (peringkat 1 = omset tertinggi).
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY peringkat

question: Per tim, ranking sales berdasarkan omset YTD. Tampilkan semua sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset_ytd, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, peringkat

question: Top 3 sales per tim berdasarkan omset 6 bulan terakhir.
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.team, x.rn

question: Jumlah tiket per minggu 8 minggu terakhir dengan selisih dari minggu sebelumnya; minggu pertama tidak usah ditampilkan.
sql: SELECT x.minggu, x.jumlah_tiket, x.jumlah_tiket - x.tiket_sebelumnya AS selisih FROM (SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tiket_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1)) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 ORDER BY x.minggu

question: Omset per kuartal tahun 2025 dan selisih dengan kuartal sebelumnya; kuartal pertama tetap ditampilkan, dibandingkan dengan 0.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, sum(d.value) - lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS selisih FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: Per segmen, omset kumulatif per bulan sepanjang tahun 2025.
sql: SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset_bulan, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date)) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY c.segment, bulan ORDER BY c.segment, bulan

question: nomor urut deal won tahun ini berdasarkan tanggal closing, 10 pertama
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nomor FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) ORDER BY nomor LIMIT 10

question: Deal won pertama (paling awal closing) untuk setiap pelanggan, tampilkan id deal, id customer, dan tanggal closing.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.customer_id, x.closed_date FROM (SELECT d.deal_id AS deal_id, d.customer_id AS customer_id, d.closed_date AS closed_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.customer_id

question: Jumlah aktivitas per bulan 12 bulan terakhir beserta rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractMonths(now(), 12) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Per tim: berapa deal won dan deal lost bulan lalu?
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(d.stage = 'won') AS deal_won, countIf(d.stage = 'lost') AS deal_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: win rate tiap sales (id dan nama) di tahun 2025
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won', 'lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 AND d.stage IN ('won', 'lost') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.rep_id

question: Jumlah tiket per prioritas, pisahkan yang dibuat tahun ini dan tahun lalu (kalender penuh).
sql: SELECT t.priority, countIf(toYear(t.created_at) = toYear(today())) AS tiket_tahun_ini, countIf(toYear(t.created_at) = toYear(today()) - 1) AS tiket_tahun_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: win rate per bulan selama kuartal 1 2026
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won', 'lost')), 2) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won', 'lost') AND toQuarter(d.closed_date) = 1 AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2026 GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Rasio tiket yang sudah resolved/closed dari semua tiket yang dibuat 90 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT round(countIf(t.status IN ('resolved', 'closed')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_selesai FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90)

question: Per segmen: pelanggan baru tahun ini yang berstatus active vs churned
sql: SELECT c.segment, countIf(c.status = 'active') AS jumlah_active, countIf(c.status = 'churned') AS jumlah_churned FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Per bulan tahun ini, jumlah aktivitas sentimen positif dan negatif
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, countIf(a.sentiment = 'positive') AS jumlah_positif, countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Omset won dan nilai deal lost per bulan selama 6 bulan terakhir
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS omset_won, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost') AS nilai_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won', 'lost') AND d.closed_date >= subtractMonths(now(), 6) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Jumlah tiket bulan ini dipecah per prioritas dalam satu baris: kolom urgent, high, medium, low
sql: SELECT countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') AS urgent, countIf(t.priority = 'high') AS high, countIf(t.priority = 'medium') AS medium, countIf(t.priority = 'low') AS low FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today())

question: Per tim: deal won dengan lama closing di bawah 30 hari vs 30 hari atau lebih, tahun 2025
sql: SELECT r.team, countIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) < 30) AS closing_cepat, countIf(dateDiff('day', d.created_date, d.closed_date) >= 30) AS closing_lambat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toYear(d.closed_date) = 2025 GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: rata-rata nilai deal won vs deal lost kuartal lalu
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rata_won, round(avgIf(d.value, d.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rata_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won', 'lost') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(subtractQuarters(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfQuarter(today())

question: Per tim sales, dari deal yang dibuat tahun ini berapa rasio yang sudah won?
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / count(), 2) AS rasio_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: Jumlah aktivitas weekday vs weekend per tipe aktivitas
sql: SELECT a.type, countIf(toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) <= 5) AS hari_kerja, countIf(toDayOfWeek(a.timestamp) >= 6) AS akhir_pekan FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY a.type

question: Per prioritas, rata-rata resolusi (jam) tiket tahun ini dan tahun lalu
sql: SELECT t.priority, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, toYear(t.created_at) = toYear(today())), 2) AS rata_resolusi_tahun_ini, round(avgIf(t.resolution_time_hours, toYear(t.created_at) = toYear(today()) - 1), 2) AS rata_resolusi_tahun_lalu FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY t.priority

question: Omset YTD sebagai rasio terhadap omset tahun lalu penuh (setahun kalender)
sql: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today())) / sumIf(d.value, d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today())), 2) AS rasio_ytd_terhadap_tahun_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1))
